services.desc: Enjoy Portland from the water on this relaxed, island-style sunset cruise along the Willamette River. At approximately 2 hours, this cruise blends scenic views, tropical vibes, and a welcoming atmosphere for a memorable evening on the river. As the sun begins its descent, you’ll embark on an enchanting journey along the Willamette River: Cruise past floating homes, historic riverside properties, Waverly Country Club, and glide under 10 iconic bridges as the sky shifts with sunset colors and the city reflects on the water. blurb: Grab your crew and get out on the water! Island Style Charters brings a fun, social, and memorable experience to Portland’s riverfront with happy hour cruises, sunset views, tiki night parties and fully customizable private charters. Whether you’re celebrating something big or just looking for a unique night out, our island-style boat is the perfect place to relax, connect, and enjoy the city from a new perspective.
